summary: You can now delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results with GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Air . The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and supports tasks in your JetBrains IDE or in the cloud.
takeaways: Use Copilot in Air alongside the GitHub Copilot plugin and choose the workflow that works best for you.
What’s new GitHub Copilot in Air’s agent picker : Select GitHub Copilot and use your existing Copilot subscription for coding tasks.
For cloud tasks, you’ll need a JetBrains account in an Air Teams-enabled business organization, a GitHub Copilot subscription, and Copilot enabled by your Air administrator.
